extension.summary: Particle Life v2 tuned for 32-bit Android Kodi
extension.description:
The same Particle Life v2 screensaver as "Particle Life v2 (OpenGL)", built for 32-bit Android (armeabi-v7a), as on many Fire TV sticks, Google TV boxes and the Chromecast with Google TV. Install this one if your Android or Google TV Kodi is a 32-bit app; install "Particle Life v2 (OpenGL)" on 64-bit Android and macOS. Four colours of particles attract and repel each other under a randomly generated matrix of pair forces, forming cells, chains, membranes and orbiting clusters; the rules are re-rolled on a timer so the pattern never settles into one look.
This build starts lighter for a small box: 500 particles per colour and 30 simulation steps a second. Particles per colour, steps per second, the re-roll interval, rule evolution, viscosity, force strength, interaction range, wall repulsion, hard bounds and particle size are all in the add-on settings.
extension.disclaimer: This is a native add-on: it is built per platform and Kodi version (this one: Kodi 21 Omega, 32-bit ARM Android). It needs OpenGL ES 2.0. Particle Life was created by Hunar Ahmad (https://github.com/hunar4321/life_code, MIT); this is an independent native port of the same idea with its own simulation, renderer and settings.
